pushKeys.title: Push notification keys (VAPID)
pushKeys.configured: Push keys are set on the server ✓ — notifications work.
pushKeys.notConfigured: Push keys aren't set yet. Create them here, then add them in Vercel.
pushKeys.intro: The keys are created inside your browser only. The private key is never sent to a server or saved. Copy it straight into Vercel's settings.
pushKeys.privateWarning: The private key is secret: never paste it into a chat or email. Put it only into Vercel. If you close this page before copying, just create new keys.
pushKeys.step1: Open Vercel → your project → Settings → Environment Variables.
pushKeys.step2: Add the three variables (name on the left, value on the right). For VAPID_SUBJECT use your email as mailto:.
pushKeys.step3: Click Save, then Deployments → latest → ⋯ → Redeploy.
pushKeys.step4: After the redeploy, every doctor and staff member opens "My account" and taps "Turn on". (Changing the keys later disconnects registered devices.)

support.allowChanges: Also allow them to make changes (otherwise view only)
support.rules: Access ends automatically at the end of the time you choose. You can't extend it; give access again if needed.
support.bannerView: Support session (view only): ends {time}. Every page you open is recorded in the clinic's log.
support.bannerChanges: Support session (changes allowed): ends {time}. Every page and change is recorded in the clinic's log.
support.bannerClinic: Platform support can access your clinic until {time}. End it any time in Settings → Team.

setup.title: Clinic set-up
setup.subtitle: Your branches, departments, services, rooms, packages and consent forms. Changes apply right away; nothing in use is ever deleted, only switched off.
setup.branchesHint: Each branch has its own rooms, devices and doctors' hours.
setup.mapHint: Sent to patients in WhatsApp confirmations.
setup.newBranchRoom: A first consultation room is added with the branch; add more under Rooms & devices. Set doctors' hours in Working hours.
setup.departmentsHint: Sections of the clinic, e.g. Dermatology, Laser, Dental. A department that is off is hidden with its services.
setup.servicesCount: {n, plural, one {# active service} other {# active services}}
setup.servicesHint: Everything patients can book: duration, price, who does it, device, consent and messages.
setup.bufferHint: Cleaning or setting up before the next patient.
setup.deviceHint: Only times when such a device is free are offered.
setup.doctorsHint: Tick none to let every doctor at the branch do it.
setup.recallHint: Optional: a WhatsApp recall when it's time for the next session.
setup.roomsHint: Rooms are booked together with the doctor, so two patients never share one. Devices (lasers etc.) the same.
setup.deviceTypeHint: A short name shared by identical devices, e.g. morpheus8 or pico_laser. Services ask for a type.
setup.packagesHint: Session bundles patients buy; sessions are deducted at check-in.
setup.consentsHint: Forms patients sign on their phone or at reception. Link a form to a service under Services.
setup.consentLine: Version {version} · {services, plural, =0 {not linked to a service yet} one {# service} other {# services}}
setup.consentNewHint: Have the wording checked by your legal adviser. Later changes create a new version; signed forms keep the text that was signed.

patientImport.title: Import patients
patientImport.subtitle: Bring your patient list (and their remaining package sessions) from your previous system.
patientImport.demoOnlyFake: This is a demo clinic: import made-up patients only. Never upload real patient data here.
patientImport.step1: Download the template, or export your patient list from your old system.
patientImport.step2: In Excel: File → Save As → "CSV UTF-8". Arabic or English column titles both work.
patientImport.step3: Choose the file below. We check every row first — nothing is saved until you press Import.
patientImport.columns: Needed: name, mobile, gender. Optional: file number, English name, date of birth, ID number, email, package name, sessions used, package date.
patientImport.missingColumns: The file is missing these columns: {columns}
patientImport.summary: {ready} of {total} rows are ready to import ({packages} with a package).
patientImport.problemsTitle: {n, plural, one {# row can't be imported:} other {# rows can't be imported:}}
patientImport.problemsHint: Fix these rows in Excel and import the file again — patients already imported will be skipped.
patientImport.done: Done: {imported} patients imported, {packages} packages added, {skipped} rows skipped.

problem.bad_phone: mobile is not a Saudi mobile
problem.bad_gender: gender should be male or female
problem.unknown_package: package name doesn't match any of your packages
problem.bad_sessions: sessions used is not a number or more than the package has
problem.duplicate_in_file: same patient appears twice in the file

reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: How the clinic did this month. Money is estimated from your list prices; your till stays the official record.
reports.visitValueHint: Completed visits not paid by a package, at list price
reports.clinicWideNote: Packages and new patients belong to the whole clinic, so they show under "All branches".
reports.dailyTitle: Daily file for your invoicing system
reports.dailyHint: One CSV per day with completed visits (list price, or 0 when a package paid), packages sold and package payments — ready to import into your accounting or e-invoicing (ZATCA) system.
